name: NFPA 101 — Life Safety Code
source: NFPA 101 (2024), assembly occupancy without fixed seating

rules.title: Occupant load must not exceed the floor area allows
rules.subject: occupantLoad
rules.note: Concentrated assembly use without fixed seating. A different use has a different factor; this pack does not choose the use for you.

rules.title: At least two separate means of egress
rules.subject: exitCount
rules.note: One exit is one blocked exit away from none. Occupancies above 500 require three and above 1000 require four; this pack does not yet vary the count with occupancy.

rules.title: Egress width by the capacity method
rules.subject: exitWidth
rules.note: 5 mm per person for level egress components. Stairs require 7.6 mm per person, which this rule does not distinguish.

rules.title: Minimum clear width of a door in a means of egress
rules.subject: narrowestExit
rules.note: 32 in clear width. A door narrower than this is not a means of egress however many of them there are.

rules.title: Travel distance to an exit
rules.subject: travelDistance
rules.note: 200 ft for a sprinklered assembly occupancy. An unsprinklered building is held to 45 m.
